emsa_mrv_2024.title: EMSA THETIS-MRV public emission reports, reporting period 2024 (v253, generated 23/10/2026): CO2eq = CO2 + 28·CH4 + 265·N2O holds exactly for 12,976 of 12,976 ships reporting both gases

first_year.note: First emission year covered. Allowances for year N are surrendered by 30 September of N+1.

phase_in.note: Share of verified emissions for which allowances must be surrendered, by emission year.

coverage.note: 100% between EU ports and within EU ports (at berth and in-port movements); 50% on voyages between an EU and a non-EU port. Reproduces EMSA's reported ETS emissions exactly for 86.6% of ships in 2024; the rest are route-specific derogations not modelled here.

gwp100.note: IPCC AR5 GWP100 values. Confirmed against the CO2eq figures EMSA publishes (see docs/decisions/0004).

categories_from.note: Cargo and passenger ships from 2024; offshore ships of 5000 GT or more from 2027.

ice_class_reduction.note: Ice class IA, IA Super or equivalent may surrender 5% fewer allowances until 31 December 2030.

surrender_deadline.note: Month-day in the year after the emission year.

derogations_until.note: Island and outermost-region derogations apply until 31 December 2030. When a ship's EMSA-reported ETS emissions are below the rule-based figure, the observed ratio is applied up to this year and full coverage afterwards (docs/decisions/0004).
